game: Swell Rider: an arcade three.js jet ski racer on open ocean; bright, fast, splashy, sunny, six skis over three laps with ramps and big air

cues.trigger: src/systems/AudioSystem.ts engine(), every frame while riding; playbackRate and gain follow speed, throttle, boost and air
cues.want: a real small motorboat or jet ski engine running steadily on the water, close, continuous mechanical drone with no start or stop

cues.trigger: src/systems/AudioSystem.ts engine(), hull on the water; gain follows speed, silent in the air
cues.want: continuous rushing water spray and hiss of a fast boat hull cutting through the sea, close, no engine

cues.trigger: src/systems/AudioSystem.ts unlock(), always on under the game
cues.want: open sea ambience: gentle waves and light wind out on the water, no boats, no voices

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleEvent 'land' with impact > 2, and player 'bump' (round robin with land-splash-2)
cues.want: a heavy hull slapping down flat onto the sea after a jump: a big wet water impact splash, close, outdoor

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleEvent 'land' with impact > 2 (second variant, round robin)
cues.want: a heavy hull slapping down flat onto the sea after a jump: a big wet water impact splash, close, outdoor
a rider thrown off a jet ski and crashing into the sea at speed: a big heavy violent body splash with spray and churning water after

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleEvent 'launch' (ramp, swell crest or Space pop)
cues.want: a short water spray whoosh as a hull leaves the water surface, wet and airy
a hollow plastic or fiberglass hull knocking hard against another hull, a dull thud

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleEvent 'ring' (pitched up for air rings)
cues.want: a bright rewarding pickup chime, clean and sparkly, short
a short clear checkpoint ding, a single bell-like confirmation tone
a single short race countdown beep, electronic start-light tone
a loud air horn blast starting a race, short
a short bright positive success jingle for completing a lap
a triumphant bright achievement fanfare for a new record, short

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleRaceEvent 'finish' for the player in 1st
cues.want: a victory fanfare jingle for winning a race, triumphant and upbeat

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts handleRaceEvent 'finish' for the player not in 1st
cues.want: a short race finished jingle, neutral to positive, not a fail sound

cues.trigger: src/game/Game.ts onAction and start/resume/again buttons, pause toggle
cues.want: a soft clean short user interface button click, dry
